note: Union County park around 64-acre Moffit Lake, about 10 mi SE of Morganfield. The waterfront sites are a gravel row on the north-east shore of the lake's eastern arm; the rest sit in open ground and woods nearby, beside rustic and premium cabins. Kayak and pedal-boat rentals and a trail around the lake. Some sites go as monthly or March-November seasonals. --Claude
